46596dea-95de-40e8-b2b8-4e63aa6acd1a.title: Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei
46596dea-95de-40e8-b2b8-4e63aa6acd1a.description:
Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy's expectations by developing "magicology," a unique magical theory based on memories from her past commoner life. One day, she witnesses the brilliant noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom's next monarch. Thus Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name  somehow involving them living together and researching magic! Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures, but those of the kingdom... and the entire world!

2e886d68-1fb5-423b-9d09-2af0d8e0de5d.description:
The villainess is getting married to the villain?!  
  
Lilith, a former villainess was killed by the man she loved. She was punished for her evil deeds, but when she woke up, she looked the same as before but was a supporting character in a novel.  
  
"While I'm being abused by my stepmother every day, I'm also engaged to a trashy man?!"  
  
Determined to reflect on her past mistakes and live a good life this time, she enters into a contract marriage with the future villain of the story in order to change his fate and leave her stepmother and two stepsisters behind.  
  
"I do not need love to live a good life!"  
  
~The (now good) life of a former villainess who became the supporting character of a novel~

02b6484e-5bbf-4f86-aaeb-6ce1a52b9aa3.description:
With the power of the shogunate, Ieyasu, the supreme ruler of Japan, holds sway over the Sengoku Era. Those who refuse to follow his whims are doomed to be put to death by the god of war, Kibitsuhiko-no-Mikoto. But behold! Seven shadows are still rampant in this ruthless world. Are they men? Beasts? Petals? The wind? No, they are the seven blades of the Efu–the grudgeful ninja!  
  
Note: The Efu were the personal guards of the Emperor of Japan and his palace before the Feudal Era, following the establishment of Ritsuryō.

fa29d924-49a4-44a2-8b1e-a7b69cfb97fd.title: Garden in the Closet
fa29d924-49a4-44a2-8b1e-a7b69cfb97fd.description:
Kouki is a high school student with a large build who fits in effortlessly with the guys. Yet deep down, he often feels bewildered by the topics of their conversations and finds himself unable to openly share his extensive knowledge of plants. 

One day, a transfer student named Misaki joins their class. However — for some reason — Misaki remains completely invisible to Kouki alone. While everyone around him interacts with Misaki as if nothing's wrong, Kouki is left wondering: What kind of expressions is he wearing as he speaks to him? 

Before he knows it, Kouki finds himself constantly tracking Misaki with his eyes; through him, he is destined to confront a world he never knew existed.

9863c55e-6809-42cc-8ee4-09f00e4f1bec.title: Shirley
9863c55e-6809-42cc-8ee4-09f00e4f1bec.description:
The original five chapters of Shirley, as well as the oneshots about Nelly and Mary Banks, were first published as doujinshi around 2000-2001. In 2003, these seven chapters were collected in a single volume, published by Enterbrain. Mori would later return to Shirley with chapters published irregularly in Harta: two chapters in 2006, two in 2010, two in 2013, and two in 2014. These eight chapters were subsequently collected in a second volume, published in 2014. Additional singular chapters were published in Harta in 2018 and 2019, followed by chapters in Aokishi in 2021 and 2023.
___
Volume 1 also includes short stories about two other maids:
* "An Afternoon with Nelly and Me", a story about a maid who becomes the playmate of the young son of the house where she serves.
* "Mary Banks", the story of a maid working for an elderly master who loves playing pranks on his servants, yet she still cares for him.
___
Just "Shirley" or "Shirley Medison/Madison"?
When published as individual chapters in magazines, the title is "Shirley Medison", while the tankobon volumes are named simply "Shirley". 
When CMX published the series in English, they translated her name as "Shirley Madison", but the name of the volume remained "Shirley".

c7d93139-b172-42d9-b5d8-56c0cdb606a3.title: Kyou kara City Hunter
c7d93139-b172-42d9-b5d8-56c0cdb606a3.description:
Kaori Aoyama adalah seorang karyawati yang masih lajang di usia 40 tahun. Sejak remaja, pria idamannya adalah Ryo Saeba. Suatu hari, Kaori tertabrak kereta yang sedang melaju, namun saat tersadar, Kaori mendapati dirinya kembali ke sosoknya di masa SMA, dan hidup di alam komik “City Hunter” yang sangat disukainya.

Tak ada seorang pun yang bisa dimintai pertolongan oleh Kaori, dan tanpa sadar kakinya melangkah menuju papan pengumuman di Shinjuku. Harapan terakhirnya hanyalah huruf-huruf “XYZ”, kode untuk menghubungi City Hunter.

Di dunia City Hunter, Kaori memulai kehidupannya yang kedua!
